_readme: R-WEBSITE-13 (review website__pm lineage, fixlog/M-WEBSITE-07__r1.md disclosure D1):
the marketing pages state SERVER-enforced caps in prose ('up to 50 viewers'). Before
this fixture existed those numbers were bound to the server by nothing but a comment
cite, so a server cap change silently drifted every copy. This file is the VENDORED
cross-repo fact; test/server-cap-pins.test.mjs is the executable law that binds every
cap-shaped copy and every 'MAX_MEMBERS = <n>' comment cite to it.
Refresh protocol when a server cap changes: read the cited constant at phlix-server
master, bump the value and the provenance (including server_master_sha), move ALL
site copies in the same wave — the law reddens on any straggler copy or stale comment,
and the per-carrier floors redden if binding ever stops. This number is NOT in
shared/content.json on purpose: content.json is the marketing-FACT SSOT authored here,
while this fixture is a vendored READ of another repo's code — different provenance,
different refresh discipline, never hand-retype one into the other.
